decision: One conditional P4 component device validation approved by root after reviewed CPU preparation; no repeated parent approval required when all conditions pass
conditions: Existing unique P2 EP16 serial permit runs first. Its complete448 fixed-limit metrics,16rank initial/final actual FD/source/native identities, all four case closes and PG exits, both real node and both real supervisor rc0, no timeout/abort/new error, and exact own release must pass and be saved in a strict audit. A failure revokes this conditional successor until root designs and reviews the next diagnostic.

No other own device/control job is running or pending execution concurrently. Confirm the exact P4 RUN has not already launched or completed; reuse neither consumed permissions nor prior RUN directories.

After predecessor release, a new both-host gate must show all16 devices free, own0, no recognized foreign launcher or unresolved ownership. A known post-run external job blocks the fresh gate and imposes30minutes before recheck; it is not retroactively a proven predecessor conflict.
Exact local controller/manifest/backend and deployed control/package/native/activation bytes match their reviewed pins. Do not rebuild or repeat consumed CPU qualification as preparation.

Only then may environment create the local exact authorization JSON with device_authorized=true plus run_tag,manifest_sha256,controller_sha256,component_contract_sha256 and SO from this review, and execute the existing local controller once. The controller independently verifies deployments and fresh resources before launching. No credential is written to this JSON or any file.

busy: No worker launch means permission remains unconsumed. Stop and retain evidence. Check again at least30minutes later via the sole environment agent; do not loop unchanged commands.
failure: Any new error stops this run and all dependent stages. Save original error, real exit statuses, PID-start ownership, source/loaded-library identity and raw evidence. Only the reviewed child-first exact-own cleanup is allowed; unknown/live worker preserves recording parents. Never signal external processes or rerun unchanged failure.
permission_consumption: Consume when launch is attempted or its outcome is unknown; recover exact markers before further action. A prelaunch busy gate alone does not consume. A local output directory from a busy attempt is preserved; a future attempt needs an explicit new run_tag amendment in this review, not silent overwrite.
after: No automatic device successor. Root reviews actual results. This grants only component accuracy/identity/lifecycle validation, not full training, SHMEM fusion, physical overlap or performance qualification.
